name: Goblin Gunslinger
body:
General | Combat Stamina

Goblin Gunslinger (Combat)
Source Advanced Race Guide pg. 118
You have learned how to fire the big guns.

Prerequisites: Goblin.

Benefit: You can wield Medium firearms without taking the penalty for an inappropriately sized weapon.

Normal: You take a –2 penalty when using an inappropriately sized weapon.
Combat Trick (from the Combat Stamina feat)
Source Pathfinder Unchained pg. 120
When wielding a firearm that deals fire damage, when you threaten but fail to confirm a critical hit, you can spend 5 stamina points to regain 1 grit point. You still can’t gain a grit point if the target is immune to critical hits.
